# TITMAS canonical machine discovery pointer

Canonical agent entry: ./agent-index.json
Human-compatible entry: ./TITMAS/README.md
Conformance command: python3 TITMAS/conformance/harness.py
Agent community CLI: python3 TITMAS/agent-native/community_cli.py --help

TITMAS is the Agent-Native Standards Community for Trusted Multi-Agent
Infrastructure. It is not an Agent Runtime, executor, certification authority,
truth store or autonomous GitHub authority.

Canonical status: ./TITMAS/community/community-status.json
Current maturity: Development.
Current stage: TITMAS_STAGE_5_PRIVATE_PREVIEW.
Current core repository visibility: PRIVATE.
Public core clone available: false.
Public protocol released: false.
External trial requires explicit access: true.
External participant invitation authorized: false.

Historical public contribution templates remain recorded, but the current
public contribution workflow and Security Transport are not active. Stage 5.1
prepares an allowlist-reconstructed, separate private trial repository; it does
not export the private core, invite a participant, release a protocol or
activate commercial access.
